title: Private min pack: log pipeline health alerts + missing signals alert group
author: Sergio Costa
description:
Context: Private observability minimum pack needs “day-1 usable” alerting around log delivery. We’ve had multiple Private installs where operators only discover log drops (or SIEM export failures) when they need logs during an incident. This PR adds a baseline set of log pipeline health alerts + a “missing signals” alert group to catch broken collectors/routing early.

What’s included (PrometheusRule groups): log-pipeline-health (1) Collector backlog / queue buildup: detects sustained growth in internal queue/backlog for the supported collectors (Vector + Fluent Bit) when enabled. (2) Drop/dropped-events rate: sustained non-zero drop rate (after sampling/filtering) over a window. (3) Export failures: exporter sink errors (HTTP 4xx/5xx, connection failures) for common sinks we see in Private: syslog/TCP, HTTP, S3-compatible object storage, Splunk HEC. These are written to be sink-agnostic via consistent metric names emitted by our default configs. (4) Pipeline stalled: collector still running but no successful exports for N minutes (guarded to avoid false positives in “no traffic” envs).

missing-signals (1) Missing logs from gateway/runtime/control plane: if a component is serving traffic (or has been Ready) but we see zero ingested log records for >10m. (2) Missing collector metrics: detects when the collector endpoint stops being scraped (targets down) and suppresses downstream log-volume alerts to avoid alert storms. (3) Missing installer/upgrade controller logs: specific to the Private install health story (ties into PR-325 dashboard).

Design notes / philosophy: - Default severities map to the Private min pack paging policy: exporter failure + sustained drops are sev=page; backlog growth and missing logs are sev=ticket by default. - Rules are designed to be low-cardinality and based on existing pack labels (cluster, namespace, component, sink_type). - All “missing signals” alerts are guarded with “should have data” signals (traffic/ready) to avoid firing in idle staging clusters. - This PR adds explicit runbook_url annotations (Confluence links TBD; placeholders point to /runbooks/private/log-pipeline).

Operational impact: - No changes to dashboards yet; this PR is alert-only. - Vector/Fluent Bit metric naming: we normalize via our default configs. If a customer uses a custom collector config, they may need to map metrics to the expected names or disable these rule groups.

Testing: - promtool rule lint + unit tests added for the new groups. - Validated against staging Private VPC env with synthetic log load (gateway + runtime). - Verified alert suppression behavior when collector scrape targets are down.

Related: - ENG-2844 (log pipeline defaults) - SUP-2427 (on-prem SIEM forwarding drops) - SUP-2431 (rules not loading after upgrade; this PR follows the same validation pattern and keeps rule groups small).
commits: alerts: add log pipeline health rule group (backlog, drops, export failures)
alerts: add missing signals group (zero logs w/ traffic/ready guards)
alerts: add promtool unit tests + CI wiring for new rules
docs: add runbook_url annotations + alert descriptions
chore: align labels and recording rules with cardinality guidelines
conversation:
Sean Gallagher (SRE) 2025-02-19: For paging rules, can we make sure exporter failures page only when there is “expected export” traffic? Otherwise on cold clusters we’ll page for sinks that aren’t configured. Also request: add explicit inhibition so missing-scrape/targets down doesn’t cause a cascade.

Sergio Costa 2025-02-19: Updated. Export failure alert now gates on export_attempts > 0 in the last 15m (and an opt-in label sink_enabled=\"true\" from default configs). Added inhibition: MissingCollectorScrapes inhibits LogDrops/BacklogGrowth.

Allison Grant 2025-02-20: Missing signals rules look good. Please keep label set minimal—don’t include full sink endpoint or customer-specific IDs. Also add a note in the rule annotations about common false positives (e.g., sampling filters).

Sergio Costa 2025-02-20: Confirmed: labels are sink_type only, no endpoint. Added annotation “check sampling/filtering” and “verify collector buffers”.

Kevin Osei 2025-02-20: For Splunk HEC / HTTP export failures, do we distinguish auth errors (4xx) vs 5xx? Customers often misconfigure tokens and would benefit from a clearer message.

Sergio Costa 2025-02-20: Yes. Split exporter failures into two alerts: ExportAuthErrors (4xx) = sev=ticket by default, ExportTransportErrors (5xx/conn) = sev=page (with expected-traffic gate). Unit tests added.

Markus Klein 2025-02-21: Looks aligned with what we see in installs. One ask: the backlog threshold seems aggressive for on-prem where storage is slower; can we make it a ratio (growth rate) and allow tuning in values.yaml later?

Sergio Costa 2025-02-21: Adjusted to use backlog growth rate over 30m rather than absolute backlog size. Added TODO note referencing ENG-2844 to surface thresholds via chart values; for now, these are conservative defaults.

Fatima Noor 2025-02-21: Air-gapped installs often have delayed scrapes during bootstrap. Ensure missing-scrapes doesn’t fire during the first N minutes.

Sergio Costa 2025-02-21: Added a for: 20m on MissingCollectorScrapes and a guard on cluster_uptime_seconds > 1800 where available (falls back gracefully if metric absent).
release_notes: Private min pack now includes baseline alerts for log pipeline health (collector backlog/drops/export failures) and a missing-signals group to detect broken logging early.
